newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Bank of NZ completes sale/leaseback of branches.
newsitem.headline: Bank of NZ completes sale/leaseback of branches.

text.p: The Bank of New Zealand said on Thursday it had successfully completed the third and final stage of its sale and leaseback of 45 branch properties.
All 10 of the bank's branches offered for sale and leaseback in an auction in Christchurch on Thursday sold for a collective value of NZ$4.8 million.
The properties, all located in the South Island, will be leased back to the bank for commercial lease periods of six years, with ongoing rights of renewal.
The auction follows others this week in Auckland and Wellington. The total portfolio of 45 properties sold for more than NZ$26 million, against an estimated value of NZ$25 million.
